projects.name: AI-Native Developer Platform
projects.tagline: A security-first platform for building AI developer tools: multi-model routing, safe agents, code intelligence and enterprise controls.

projects.name: Tavrion Studio
projects.tagline: A VS Code-style IDE that opens, builds, runs and debugs Eclipse Java projects.

projects.name: DevFlow
projects.tagline: One VS Code extension for the daily developer workflow: Environment Doctor, Git Assistant, Build Doctor, API Workspace and a Project Dashboard.

projects.name: Salesforce DevPilot Pack
projects.tagline: A Salesforce developer pack for VS Code built around a Change Impact Analyzer, with health and release checks that run locally.

projects.name: JarPilot for IBM i
projects.tagline: Fast, safe JAR installation on the IBM i IFS: validate, checksum, back up, replace atomically and roll back with one command.

projects.name: Routinel – API Finder & Client
projects.tagline: Finds every HTTP API in your workspace, in any supported language, and calls it from a built-in Postman-style client.

projects.name: DevSuite
projects.tagline: One shared analysis engine and five focused VS Code extensions: RepoPilot, DevImpact, CodeGuard, TraceLens and BugTrail.

projects.name: IBM i & z/OS Explorer
projects.tagline: One VS Code sidebar for IBM i (SSH + SQL) and z/OS (z/OSMF): data sets, members, IFS, USS, JCL, spool and commands.

projects.name: Vanthrex for IBM i
projects.tagline: An all-in-one IBM i workbench for VS Code: connect, edit, compile, SQL, code checks, debugging and system tools.
